title: "Who plays your opening?"
subtitle: "How often an opening is played, online on Lichess and over the board in top players' classical games, split into White's choices and Black's — and how often you'd meet it compared with your opponent"
# Self-contained page options, so the page renders the same inside the site
# (which supplies the theme and declares the scripts + data/** as resources).

  html:
    # dash.css is linked with the release version (cache-busting), not via `css:`

    toc: false
    page-layout: full
    anchor-sections: false

  echo: false
resources:
  - dash.css
  - dash.js

  - controls.js
  - export.js
  - data/index.json
  - data/positions.json

  - data/otb/nodes/*.json
  - pieces/*.svg
  - pieces/LICENSE.txt
  - pieces/SOURCES.json

::: {.dash-lede}
Play a line on the board, or pick one of the 3,810 named openings below it, then choose the games: **Lichess online
games**, by speed and rating, or **classical over-the-board games** among top players (the SuperGMs, or one of 47
leading players as White, Black or either). **True reach** is the share of games
that reach the position by any move order. Because moves alternate, the share along *your* move order factorises
exactly into **W**, the product of White's choices, times **B**, the product of Black's. The same factors answer a
second question: if you always play the line, you get it whenever your *opponent* cooperates.
:::

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Every module and data file is loaded with ?v=<VERSION>, a content hash of the
// release stamped by python/stamp_release.py, so a deploy never mixes with a
// browser's cached copy of the previous release (GitHub Pages sends max-age=600,
// and module caches can outlive it).
VERSION = "228b2592ec10"
asset = (path) => new URL(`${path}?v=${VERSION}`, document.baseURI).href
dashMod = import(asset("dash.js"))
boardMod = import(asset("board.js"))
controlsMod = import(asset("controls.js"))
exportMod = import(asset("export.js"))
makeStore = dashMod.makeStore
toPlain = dashMod.toPlain
otbAs = dashMod.otbAs
toPlainCompare = dashMod.toPlainCompare
monthDate = dashMod.monthDate
monthLabel = dashMod.monthLabel
createBoard = boardMod.createBoard
multiSelect = controlsMod.multiSelect
bandSummary = controlsMod.bandSummary
selectBox = controlsMod.selectBox
combobox = controlsMod.combobox
chartWithDownload = exportMod.chartWithDownload
exportChart = exportMod.exportChart
EXPORT_FONT = exportMod.EXPORT_FONT
slugify = exportMod.slug
Plot = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/+esm")
ChessLib = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chess.js@1.4.0/dist/esm/chess.js")
store = makeStore("data", VERSION)
ix = store.loadIndex()
COL = ({ white: "#2a78d6", black: "#eb6834", draw: "#b9b8b0", reach: "#1baf7a", prod: "#52514e", ink: "#0b0b0b", muted: "#898781", grid: "#e1e0d9" })
M = ix.n_months
openingRows = ix.openings.map((o) => ({ id: o.id, eco: o.eco, name: o.name, moves: ix.pgn(o.moves), line: o.moves, plies: o.moves.length, rank: o.rank }))
ITALIAN = ["e4", "e5", "Nf3", "Nc6", "Bc4"]
// Shareable state in the URL hash:
//   #moves=e4,e5,Nf3&speeds=Blitz,Rapid&bands=1600,1800&from=2019-01&to=2021-12&smooth=3&metric=results&zoom=score&view=levels
//   (from= defaults to 2017-01 and to= to the latest month; both are written only when they differ;
//   metric=results opens panel 1 on Win percentage and is written only then: Popularity is the default;
//   zoom=score opens Win percentage on "Score only (zoomed)", is written only then, and is ignored without metric=results)
// (#opening=<id> from v1 links still works: it sets the board to that line)
// v1.9, the Compare tab:
//   #moves=e4,c5,Nf3,Nc6,Bb5&tab=compare&a.speeds=Bullet,Blitz&a.bands=0,1000&b.speeds=Rapid&b.bands=2000,2200,2500
//   tab=compare opens the Compare tab and is written only while it is selected (links without tab= open on Explore).
//   a.speeds / a.bands / b.speeds / b.bands set Set A and Set B, each written only when it differs from the
//   default (Set A: all speeds, bands 0/1000/1200/1400, i.e. under 1600; Set B: all speeds, bands 2000/2200/2500).
//   speeds= / bands= stay Explore's filters; moves, from/to and smooth are shared by both tabs.
// v2.0, the Classical OTB Games source (data/otb/, loaded only once a set uses it):
//   #moves=e4,c5,Nf3,Nc6,Bb5&src=otb&who=carlsen&as=white
//   #moves=e4,c5,Nf3,Nc6,Bb5&tab=compare&a.bands=2000,2200,2500&b.src=otb
//   src=otb (Explore) / a.src=otb / b.src=otb pick the source (default lichess); who= / a.who= / b.who= the
//   OTB set (default supergm, the elite set; else a roster slug such as carlsen); as= / a.as= / b.as= the
//   player's colour (white | black; default either). Each is written only when it differs from the default,
//   and who/as only for an OTB set (as only for a player). OTB pools a rolling 12 months, and so does
//   Compare whenever either set is OTB; the 3-month pooling (smooth=3) applies to Lichess-only views.
//   The window runs to 2026-10 when every set in view is OTB, else to Lichess's last month (2026-07);
//   to= is written only when the window ends before the view's last month. Links without these keys
//   open exactly as in v1.9.
hashParams = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1))
hashList = (k) => hashParams.has(k) ? hashParams.get(k).split(",").filter(Boolean) : null
// v2.0: the window selectors run over both sources' months: OTB_MONTHS is data/otb/index.json's
// n_months (2013-01..2026-10), fixed here so the selectors need no OTB fetch (checked when it loads).
OTB_MONTHS = 166
MU = Math.max(M, OTB_MONTHS)
monthIndex = (s) => {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/.exec(s ?? "");
  const [y0, mm0] = ix.first_month.split("-").map(Number);
  return m ? Math.max(0, Math.min(MU - 1, (+m[1] - y0) * 12 + (+m[2] - mm0))) : null;
}
// The window opens on 2017-01 .. latest month by default (2013-2016 is the early,
// thin Lichess era); #from= / #to= override it. A link that gives only an early
// #to= (v1.4 omitted from= when it was the first month) keeps meaning "from the start".
DEFAULT_FROM = monthIndex("2017-01") ?? 0
hashMonth = (k, dflt) => monthIndex(hashParams.get(k)) ?? dflt
fromDefault = (hashMonth("to", MU - 1) < DEFAULT_FROM) ? 0 : DEFAULT_FROM
// v2.0: the last month of the view a link opens on (all sets in view OTB: 2026-10; else 2026-07)
MviewInit = (hashParams.get("tab") === "compare" ? hashSrc("a.") === "otb" && hashSrc("b.") === "otb" : hashSrc("") === "otb") ? OTB_MONTHS : M
initialMoves = hashList("moves") ?? (hashParams.has("opening") ? ix.byId.get(+hashParams.get("opening"))?.moves : null) ?? ITALIAN
// v1.9: the Compare tab's two filter sets (owner's defaults: under 1600 vs 2000+, all speeds)
DEFAULT_A = ({ speeds: ix.speeds, bands: [0, 1000, 1200, 1400] })
DEFAULT_B = ({ speeds: ix.speeds, bands: [2000, 2200, 2500] })
SET = ({ a: "#0b0b0b", b: "#1baf7a" })   // Set A ink, Set B aqua (White and Black keep #2a78d6 / #eb6834)
// v2.0: the source of a set and, for OTB, who and the colour ("" = Explore's keys, "a." / "b." = the sets')
SRC_OPTIONS = [["lichess", "Lichess Online Games"], ["otb", "Classical OTB Games"]]
AS_OPTIONS = [["either", "Either"], ["white", "White"], ["black", "Black"]]
hashSrc = (pre) => hashParams.get(`${pre}src`) === "otb" ? "otb" : "lichess"
hashWho = (pre) => /^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(hashParams.get(`${pre}who`) ?? "") ? hashParams.get(`${pre}who`) : "supergm"
hashAs = (pre) => ["white", "black"].includes(hashParams.get(`${pre}as`)) ? hashParams.get(`${pre}as`) : "either"
hashSet = (k, D0) => ({
  src: hashSrc(`${k}.`), who: hashWho(`${k}.`), as: hashAs(`${k}.`),
  speeds: hashList(`${k}.speeds`)?.filter((s) => ix.speeds.includes(s)) ?? D0.speeds,
  bands: hashList(`${k}.bands`)?.map(Number).filter((b) => ix.bands.includes(b)) ?? D0.bands })
// the Who list: SuperGMs pinned first, then the roster by name, each with its classical game count
whoOptions = (oix) => {
  const f = d3.format(",");
  const sg = oix.who[0];
  return [{ id: sg.id, text: "SuperGMs", hint: `${f(sg.games)} games`, match: "elite super grandmasters supergm" },
    ...oix.who.slice(1).slice().sort((a, b) => (a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0)).map((w) => ({ id: w.id, text: w.name, hint: `${f(w.games)} games`, match: w.full }))];
}
// a Who combobox; its list is filled once the OTB index is loaded (fillWho), never before OTB is chosen
whoControl = (init, cls = "") => {
  const c = combobox({ label: "Who", value: init, pendingText: init === "supergm" ? "SuperGMs" : "…" });
  if (cls) c.classList.add(...cls.split(" "));
  return c;
}
fillWho = (c) => store.otbIndex().then((oix) => {
  if (oix.n_months !== OTB_MONTHS) console.error(`data/otb/index.json n_months ${oix.n_months} != OTB_MONTHS ${OTB_MONTHS}`);
  c.setOptions(whoOptions(oix), "supergm");
})
// One set's row on the Compare tab: a colour swatch, its name, and its own Speed and Rating dropdowns
// (controls.js). .value = { speeds, bands }; an "input" event fires on every change.
// v2.0: each row also has its own Source; Lichess shows Speed and Rating, Classical OTB shows Who and,
// for a player, Plays as. .value = { src, speeds, bands, who, as } (the hidden filters keep their values).
setControl = (name, color, init) => {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "dash-set";
  row.setAttribute("role", "group");
  row.setAttribute("aria-label", `${name} filters`);
  const lab = document.createElement("span");
  lab.className = "dash-set-k";
  lab.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-swatch" style="background:${color}" aria-hidden="true"></span>${name}`;
  const src = selectBox({ label: "Source", options: SRC_OPTIONS, value: init.src, className: "dash-src" });
  const sp = multiSelect({ label: "Speed", options: ix.speeds, value: init.speeds });
  const bd = multiSelect({ label: "Rating", options: ix.bands, value: init.bands,
    format: (b) => ix.band_labels[ix.bands.indexOf(b)], summary: bandSummary(ix.bands, ix.band_labels) });
  const who = whoControl(init.who);
  const as = selectBox({ label: "Plays as", options: AS_OPTIONS, value: init.as, className: "dash-as" });
  row.append(lab, src, sp, bd, who, as);
  let filled = false;
  const upd = () => {
    row.value = { src: src.value, speeds: sp.value, bands: bd.value, who: who.value, as: as.value };
    row.classList.toggle("is-otb", src.value === "otb");
    row.classList.toggle("is-player", who.value !== "supergm");
    if (src.value === "otb" && !filled) { filled = true; fillWho(who); }
  };
  for (const c of [src, sp, bd, who, as]) c.addEventListener("input", upd);   // runs before the event bubbles to the row's own listeners
  upd();
  row.controls = { src, speeds: sp, bands: bd, who, as };
  return row;
}
```

```{ojs}
// v1.9: Explore | Compare. An ARIA tablist like the ratings page's (dnield.com/ratings), keyboard
// operable: Tab reaches the selected tab, the arrow keys, Home and End move and select.
viewof tab = {
  const nav = document.createElement("div");
  nav.className = "dash-tabs";
  nav.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
  nav.setAttribute("aria-label", "Dashboard views");
  const btns = [["explore", "Explore"], ["compare", "Compare"]].map(([id, label]) => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.id = `dash-tab-${id}`;
    b.dataset.tab = id;
    b.setAttribute("role", "tab");
    b.setAttribute("aria-controls", `dash-${id}`);
    b.textContent = label;
    nav.appendChild(b);
    return b;
  });
  const show = (id, focus) => btns.forEach((b) => {
    const on = b.dataset.tab === id;
    b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
    b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    if (on && focus) b.focus();
  });
  const set = (id, focus) => {
    show(id, focus);
    if (nav.value === id) return;
    nav.value = id;
    nav.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  btns.forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => set(b.dataset.tab, false)));
  nav.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const i = btns.findIndex((b) => b.dataset.tab === nav.value), n = btns.length;
    const j = { ArrowRight: (i + 1) % n, ArrowLeft: (i - 1 + n) % n, Home: 0, End: n - 1 }[e.key];
    if (j === undefined) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    set(btns[j].dataset.tab, true);
  });
  nav.value = hashParams.get("tab") === "compare" ? "compare" : "explore";
  show(nav.value, false);
  return nav;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Which tab shows: a class on <body> (dash.css hides the other tab's panel, Explore's Speed and Rating
// cells on Compare and the set rows on Explore), and the tab panels' ARIA roles.
{
  document.body.classList.toggle("dash-tab-compare", tab === "compare");
  for (const id of ["explore", "compare"]) {
    const el = document.getElementById(`dash-${id}`);
    if (!el) continue;
    el.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
    el.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", `dash-tab-${id}`);
    el.hidden = (id === "compare") !== (tab === "compare");
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
  // named); off the tree, the deepest named position before it, "+ k moves".
  const re = offTree ? await reentry : null;
  const named = re && re.o ? { o: re.o, at: line.length } : namedAlong;
  const depth = re && re.o ? line.length : (offTree ? line.length : treeLine.length);
  let title = named ? `<span class="eco">${esc(named.o.eco)}</span>${esc(named.o.name)}` : "Start position";
  if (named && named.at < depth) title += ` <span class="dash-after">+ ${depth - named.at} move${depth - named.at > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>`;
  let note = "";
  if (offTree) {
    const at = `${Math.floor(inTree / 2) + 1}.${inTree % 2 ? ".." : ""} ${esc(line[inTree])}`;
    note = `<div class="dash-off"><b>Outside the data.</b> ${at} leaves the named-opening tree: the data cover the 7,855

      up to ${inTree ? `<span class="dash-moves">${esc(lineText(treeLine))}</span>` : "the start position"}.</div>`;
    if (re && re.o) note += `<div class="dash-off back"><b>Back in the tree:</b> this position is
      <b>${esc(re.o.eco)} ${esc(re.o.name)}</b>, but your move order passes through positions outside the tree, so W and B
      can't be followed along it. <button type="button" class="dash-link" data-opening="${re.o.id}">Show it by its named order</button></div>`;
  }
  const d = D(`<div class="dash-chosen">${title}</div><div class="dash-moves">${esc(lineText(line))}</div>${note}`);
  d.querySelectorAll("button[data-opening]").forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("click", () => viewof line.setLine(ix.byId.get(+b.dataset.opening).moves)));
  return d;
}
```

```{ojs}
  return d;
```

```{ojs}
// v2.0: Explore's set, and the view's last month (Lichess 2026-07; all sets in view OTB: 2026-10)
specE = srcE === "otb" ? ({ src: "otb", who: whoE, as: asE }) : ({ src: "lichess", speeds, bands })
anyOtbC = setA.src === "otb" || setB.src === "otb"
MviewE = srcE === "otb" ? OTB_MONTHS : M
MviewC = setA.src === "otb" && setB.src === "otb" ? OTB_MONTHS : M
Mview = tab === "compare" ? MviewC : MviewE
m1 = Math.min(Math.max(period.from, period.to), Mview - 1)
m0 = Math.min(period.from, period.to, m1)
// pooling: OTB a fixed rolling 12 months; Compare pools both sets at 12 whenever either is OTB
smoothE = srcE === "otb" ? 12 : (pooled ? 3 : 1)
smoothC = anyOtbC ? 12 : (pooled ? 3 : 1)
smooth = smoothE
res = store.computeSet(line, specE, m0, m1, smoothE)
inTree = res.line.inTree
treeLine = line.slice(0, inTree)
offTree = inTree < line.length
// the named opening at a node: prefer the one whose moves are exactly this
// line; else the shortest named line ending there (all share the position)
nameAt = (node, moves) => {
  const c = ix.namesAt.get(node);
  if (!c) return null;
  const key = moves.join(" ");
  return c.find((o) => o.moves.join(" ") === key) ?? [...c].sort((a, b) => a.moves.length - b.moves.length || a.rank - b.rank)[0];
}
// deepest named position along the in-tree part of the line
namedAlong = {
  let v = ix.root, best = null;
  const nodes = [ix.root, ...res.line.edges.map((e) => e.child)];
  for (let i = nodes.length - 1; i >= 0 && !best; i--) {
    const o = nameAt(nodes[i], treeLine.slice(0, i));
    if (o) best = { o, at: i };
  }
  return best;
}
// a line that left the tree may have come back into it (a transposition
// through positions outside S): recognise the position by its FEN
reentry = offTree ? store.nodeOfFen(viewof line.fen()).then((v) => (v === null ? null : { node: v, o: nameAt(v, []) })) : null
rows = res.cnt ? d3.range(m0, m1 + 1).map((m, j) => {
  const s = res.ser, a = res.att;
  const r = { m, date: monthDate(ix, m), label: monthLabel(ix, m) };
  for (const k of ["W", "B", "WxB", "reach", "gap", "E_white", "E_black", "edge_white", "edge_black",
                   "edge_white_reach", "edge_black_reach", "W_lo", "W_hi", "B_lo", "B_hi", "reach_lo", "reach_hi",
                   "win_w", "win_d", "win_b", "score", "score_lo", "score_hi", "res_n",
                   "spec_edge_white", "spec_edge_black", "spec_edge_white_lo", "spec_edge_white_hi",
                   "spec_edge_black_lo", "spec_edge_black_hi"])
    r[k] = Number.isFinite(s[k][m]) ? s[k][m] : NaN;
  r.c_W = a.c_W[j]; r.c_B = a.c_B[j]; r.c_total = a.c_total[j];
  return r;
}) : []
win = res.cnt ? res.win : ({ c: [], T: [], n: [] })
// v2.0: OTB set names (the roster's names arrive with the OTB index, loaded only when a set uses it)
oix = srcE === "otb" || anyOtbC ? store.otbIndex() : null
OTB_CREDIT = "OTB: The Week in Chess, Lichess broadcasts and other archives, deduplicated"
SG_RULE = "higher-rated player >2700, other ≥2600"
fullOf = (who) => who === "supergm" ? "SuperGMs" : (oix?.byWho.get(who)?.full ?? who)
shortOf = (who) => oix?.byWho.get(who)?.short ?? who
otbDesc = (S) => S.who === "supergm" ? `SuperGMs (${SG_RULE})`
  : `${fullOf(S.who)}${otbAs(S) === "either" ? ", either colour" : ` as ${otbAs(S) === "white" ? "White" : "Black"}`}`
// a player with a colour chosen: "white" | "black" (the panels then name the player and the opponents)
playerSide = (S) => S.src === "otb" && S.who !== "supergm" && otbAs(S) !== "either" ? otbAs(S) : null
pside = playerSide(specE)
pname = pside ? shortOf(whoE) : null
// board side "W" | "B" -> who plays it in this set: the player's name, "Opponents", or null (no player)
sideWho = (side) => !pside ? null : ((side === "W") === (pside === "white") ? pname : "Opponents")
sideMoves = (side) => `${sideWho(side) === "Opponents" ? "Opponents'" : `${sideWho(side)}'s`} moves (${side === "W" ? "White" : "Black"})`
popNote = {
  if (srcE === "otb") {
    // v2.0.1: no minimum game count for OTB, so a point is missing only where no game supports it; say why
    const noWB = rows.length > 0 && !rows.some((d) => Number.isFinite(d.W));
    const noReach = rows.length > 0 && !rows.some((d) => Number.isFinite(d.reach));
    const thin = noReach ? " No game in this set reaches this position in the window."
      : noWB ? " No monthly W and B here: in every point's 12 months some move of this order was not played." : "";
    return `Classical OTB, ${otbDesc(specE)}, ${monthLabel(ix, m0)}–${monthLabel(ix, m1)}, rolling 12 months (each monthly point pools the trailing 12).${thin}`;
  }
  const sp = speeds.length === ix.speeds.length ? "all speeds" : (speeds.join(" + ") || "no speeds");
  const bl = bands.length === ix.bands.length ? "all ratings" : (bands.map((b) => ix.band_labels[ix.bands.indexOf(b)]).join(", ") || "no ratings");
  return `Lichess rated standard games (no arena/swiss, no bots), ${monthLabel(ix, m0)}–${monthLabel(ix, m1)}, ${sp}, ${bl}. `
    + (smooth === 3 ? "Monthly, counts pooled over 3 months." : "Monthly.");
}
pct = (x, d = 1) => !Number.isFinite(x) ? "—" : x >= 0.1 ? `${(100 * x).toFixed(d)}%` : x >= 0.001 ? `${(100 * x).toFixed(d + 1)}%` : `${(100 * x).toPrecision(2)}%`
tickPct = (d) => d3.format("~%")(+d.toPrecision(6))
// Log-axis ticks at 1/2/3/5, 1/3 or 1 x 10^k depending on the span, so a wide
// range never draws a thicket of unlabeled minor ticks.
logTicks = (vals) => {
  const v = vals.filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x) && x > 0);
  // v2.0: no data at all (every month suppressed, common for a thin OTB set): no y ticks, rather than
  // Plot's default 1..10 log ticks, whose labels crowd in a short export
  if (!v.length) return [];
  const lo = d3.min(v), hi = d3.max(v), span = Math.log10(hi / lo);
  if (span < 0.6) return d3.ticks(lo, hi, 5).filter((t) => t > 0);   // narrow range: plain nice ticks
  const mult = span > 2.5 ? [1] : span > 1.2 ? [1, 3] : [1, 2, 3, 5];
  const out = [];
  for (let e = Math.floor(Math.log10(lo)) - 1; e <= Math.ceil(Math.log10(hi)); e++)
    for (const mlt of mult) { const t = +(mlt * 10 ** e).toPrecision(6); if (t >= lo / 1.15 && t <= hi * 1.15) out.push(t); }
  return out.length >= 2 ? out : undefined;
}
oneIn = (p) => !Number.isFinite(p) || p <= 0 ? "—" : p >= 0.5 ? `1 in ${(1 / p).toFixed(1)}` : `1 in ${d3.format(",")(Math.round(1 / p))}`
// the specialist edge, two decimals below 10 (1.87×, 0.53×)
times2 = (x) => !Number.isFinite(x) ? "—" : x >= 10 ? `${d3.format(",")(Math.round(x))}×` : `${x.toFixed(2)}×`
key = (color, kind = "solid") => `<span class="dash-key ${kind}" style="border-color:${color};${kind === "box" ? `background:${color}` : ""}"></span>`
esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[c])
D = (s) => { const d = document.createElement("div"); d.innerHTML = s; return d; }
font = ({ fontFamily: "'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif", fontSize: "12px", background: "transparent", overflow: "visible" })
lineText = (moves) => moves.length ? ix.pgn(moves) : "the start position"
// keep the URL in step with the state, so any view can be shared
{
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  p.set("moves", line.join(","));
  if (speeds.length !== ix.speeds.length) p.set("speeds", speeds.join(","));
  if (bands.length !== ix.bands.length) p.set("bands", bands.join(","));
  // v2.0: the source, and for OTB who and the colour (each only when it differs from the default)
  const otbKeys = (pre, S) => {
    if (S.src !== "otb") return;
    p.set(`${pre}src`, "otb");
    if (S.who !== "supergm") { p.set(`${pre}who`, S.who); if (otbAs(S) !== "either") p.set(`${pre}as`, otbAs(S)); }
  };
  otbKeys("", specE);
  if (m0 !== DEFAULT_FROM) p.set("from", monthLabel(ix, m0));
  if (m1 !== Mview - 1) p.set("to", monthLabel(ix, m1));
  if (pooled) p.set("smooth", "3");
  if (metric1 === "Win percentage") p.set("metric", "results");
  if (zoom1) p.set("zoom", "score");
  if (view2 === "Levels") p.set("view", "levels");
  // v1.9: the Compare tab (only while selected) and its two sets (each only when it differs from the default)
  if (tab === "compare") p.set("tab", "compare");
  const same = (x, y) => x.length === y.length && x.every((v) => y.includes(v));
  for (const [k, S, D0] of [["a", setA, DEFAULT_A], ["b", setB, DEFAULT_B]]) {
    otbKeys(`${k}.`, S);
    if (!same(S.speeds, D0.speeds)) p.set(`${k}.speeds`, S.speeds.join(","));
    if (!same(S.bands, D0.bands)) p.set(`${k}.bands`, S.bands.join(","));
  }
  history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + p.toString().replace(/%2C/g, ","));
}
// What a chart describes, for its PNG export. The panels follow the line up
// to its last in-tree position (treeLine), so that is the move order named.
chartName = {
  if (!treeLine.length) return { title: "Start position", subtitle: "Move order: none (the start position)", slug: "start-position" };
  const nm = namedAlong;
  const exact = nm && nm.at === treeLine.length && nm.o.moves.join(" ") === treeLine.join(" ");
  const base = nm ? `${nm.o.eco} ${nm.o.name}` : "Unnamed line";
  let subtitle = `Move order: ${ix.pgn(treeLine)}`;
  if (offTree) subtitle += `. The entered line, ${ix.pgn(line)}, leaves the named-opening tree after this; the chart follows it up to here.`;
  return {
    title: exact ? base : `${base} (via ${ix.pgn(treeLine)})`,
    subtitle,
    slug: nm ? `${nm.o.eco}_${slugify(nm.o.name)}` : "line",
  };
}
// v2.0: an OTB export names its set in the subtitle and credits the OTB archives; a Lichess export is as v1.9
exportSpec = (panel, panelSlug, build, legend, footNote) => ({
  build, legend,
  title: `${chartName.title} — ${panel}`,
  subtitle: srcE === "otb" ? `Classical OTB, ${otbDesc(specE)}, rolling 12 months. ${chartName.subtitle}` : chartName.subtitle,
  footer: footNote ? `${popNote} ${footNote}` : popNote,
  source: srcE === "otb" ? `Source: dnield.com/openings · ${OTB_CREDIT}` : "Source: dnield.com/openings · Lichess open database",
  filename: `opening_${chartName.slug}_${panelSlug}_${monthLabel(ix, m0)}_${monthLabel(ix, m1)}.png`,
})
// On-screen charts are built with no preset (P undefined) and keep their fixed size and fonts.
// A PNG export passes its preset: the banner keeps the v1.5 look exactly; the others get
// phone-readable type (P.f.axis px) and margins/ticks sized to it, and the height the layout
// leaves. mlK: widest y tick label, in em, so marginLeft follows the font size.
plotLayout = (P, h, w, { hDefault, mlBanner, mlK }) => {
  if (!P) return { height: hDefault, marginLeft: mlBanner, marginTop: 30, style: font };
  if (P.legacy) return { height: hDefault, marginLeft: mlBanner, marginTop: 30, style: { ...font, fontFamily: EXPORT_FONT, fontSize: "13px" } };
  const ml = Math.round(P.f.axis * mlK);
  return { height: h, marginLeft: ml, marginTop: Math.round(P.f.axis * 2.9), marginBottom: Math.round(P.f.axis * 2.5),
           style: { ...font, fontFamily: EXPORT_FONT, fontSize: `${P.f.axis}px` } };
}
// fewer x ticks on a narrow export, so the year/month labels do not collide
// y ticks: at most one per 2.4 lines of text in the plot's height (a thinned subset of the list)
yMax = (P, L) => P && !P.legacy ? Math.max(2, Math.floor((L.height - L.marginTop - L.marginBottom) / (P.f.axis * 2.4))) : Infinity
thin = (a, k) => !a || a.length <= k ? a : Array.from({ length: k }, (_, i) => a[Math.round(i * (a.length - 1) / (k - 1))])
xTicks = (P, w, ml) => P && !P.legacy ? { ticks: Math.max(2, Math.floor((w - ml - 24) / (P.f.axis * 6.2))), tickPadding: Math.round(P.f.axis * 0.45) } : {}
// gate-4 hook: the page's own numbers for any line, read back through the browser pane
{
  window.dashCompute = async (moves, sp, bd, a, b, sm) => {
    const r = await store.compute(moves, sp, bd, a, b, sm);
    const out = toPlain(r, a, b);
    out.explorer = await store.explorer(r.line.node, sp, bd, a, b);
    return out;
  };
  // v1.9: the Compare tab's numbers (sets A, B = { speeds, bands }) for gate 4's compare group
  window.dashCompare = async (moves, A, B, a, b, sm) => toPlainCompare(await store.compare(moves, A, B, a, b, sm), a, b);
  // v2.0: any set spec ({ src: "otb", who, as } or { speeds, bands }) through the same code the panels use
  window.dashComputeSet = async (moves, S, a, b, sm) => {
    const r = await store.computeSet(moves, S, a, b, sm);
    const out = toPlain(r, a, b);
    out.explorer = await store.explorerSet(r.line.node, S, a, b);
    return out;
  };
  window.dashOtbIndex = () => store.otbIndex();
  window.dashIndex = ix;
  return true;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// v2.0, windowFit: the To (and From) lists offer only the months of the sets in view, and a To at the
// view's last month follows it (2026-07 <-> 2026-10) when the view changes.
{
  const f = viewof period, [sf, st] = f.querySelectorAll("select");
  const last = f.lastView ?? Mview;
  for (const sel of [sf, st]) for (const o of sel.options) { const off = +o.value >= Mview; o.hidden = off; o.disabled = off; }
  f.lastView = Mview;
  for (const [sel, isTo] of [[sf, false], [st, true]]) {
    const i = +sel.value;
    const want = i >= Mview ? Mview - 1 : (isTo && i === last - 1 && Mview > last ? Mview - 1 : i);
    // the select's own input event: Inputs.select takes the new value and the form passes it on
    if (want !== i) { sel.value = String(want); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); }
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Win percentage, score only: the average score and its 95% band on an axis fitted to the
// window (score_lo..score_hi, suppressed months ignored) with 10% padding each side, at least
// 0.04 wide so a very stable opening is not zoomed into noise, and never outside [0, 1].
zoomDomain = {
  const v = rows.flatMap((d) => [d.score_lo, d.score_hi]).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const lo = v.length ? d3.min(v) : 0.5, hi = v.length ? d3.max(v) : 0.5, padY = 0.1 * (hi - lo);
  let a = lo - padY, b = hi + padY;
  if (b - a < 0.04) { const mid = (lo + hi) / 2; a = mid - 0.02; b = mid + 0.02; }
  if (a < 0) { b = Math.min(1, b - a); a = 0; }
  if (b > 1) { a = Math.max(0, a - (b - 1)); b = 1; }
  return [a, b];
}
// ticks on whole hundredths (two decimals, as the summary's "average score 0.522"):
// the finest of 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.1 / 0.2 that gives at most k ticks
zoomTicks = (k) => {
  const [a, b] = zoomDomain;
  for (const st of [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2]) {
    const t = d3.range(Math.ceil(a / st - 1e-9), Math.floor(b / st + 1e-9) + 1).map((i) => +(i * st).toFixed(2));
    if (t.length <= k || st === 0.2) return t;
  }
}
chart1z = (w, h, P) => { const L = plotLayout(P, h, w, { hDefault: 300, mlBanner: 68, mlK: 3.6 }); return Plot.plot({
  width: w, ...L,
  x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [monthDate(ix, m0), monthDate(ix, m1)], ...xTicks(P, w, L.marginLeft) },
  y: { type: "linear", label: "average score (White's view)", domain: zoomDomain, grid: true,
       ticks: zoomTicks(Math.min(6, yMax(P, L))), tickFormat: d3.format(".2f") },
  marks: [
    ...(zoomDomain[0] <= 0.5 && 0.5 <= zoomDomain[1] ? [
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1, strokeDasharray: "4,3", ariaLabel: () => "even-rule" }),
      Plot.text([0.5], { y: (d) => d, text: () => "even", frameAnchor: "right", textAnchor: "end", lineAnchor: "bottom", dy: -3,
        fill: COL.prod, ariaLabel: () => "even-label" })] : []),
    Plot.areaY(rows, { x: "date", y1: "score_lo", y2: "score_hi", fill: COL.ink, fillOpacity: 0.18, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.lineY(rows, { x: "date", y: "score", stroke: COL.ink, strokeWidth: 2.75, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1 })),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "score",
      title: (d) => `${d.label}
Score  ${sc(d.score)}  (${sc(d.score_lo)}–${sc(d.score_hi)})
${games(d.res_n)} games` })),
  ],
}) }
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
chart2 = (w, h, P) => {
  const L = plotLayout(P, h, w, { hDefault: 300, mlBanner: 68, mlK: view2 === "Levels" ? 4.9 : 3.7 });
  if (view2 === "Levels") {
    return Plot.plot({
      width: w, ...L,
      x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [monthDate(ix, m0), monthDate(ix, m1)], ...xTicks(P, w, L.marginLeft) },
      y: { type: scale1, label: "probability", tickFormat: tickPct, grid: true, ...(scale1 === "log" ? { ticks: thin(logTicks(rows.flatMap((d) => [d.W_lo, d.W_hi, d.B_lo, d.B_hi])), yMax(P, L)) } : { nice: true, ...(P && !P.legacy ? { ticks: yMax(P, L) } : {}) }) },
      marks: [
        Plot.areaY(rows, { x: "date", y1: "W_lo", y2: "W_hi", fill: COL.white, fillOpacity: 0.15, curve: "monotone-x" }),
        Plot.areaY(rows, { x: "date", y1: "B_lo", y2: "B_hi", fill: COL.black, fillOpacity: 0.15, curve: "monotone-x" }),
        Plot.lineY(rows, { x: "date", y: "W", stroke: COL.white, strokeWidth: 2, curve: "monotone-x" }),
        Plot.lineY(rows, { x: "date", y: "B", stroke: COL.black, strokeWidth: 2, curve: "monotone-x" }),
        Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1 })),
        Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "W",
          title: (d) => `${d.label}\nW (${sideWho("W") ?? "White"})  ${pct(d.W)}  (${pct(d.W_lo)}–${pct(d.W_hi)})\nB (${sideWho("B") ?? "Black"})  ${pct(d.B)}  (${pct(d.B_lo)}–${pct(d.B_hi)})` })),
      ],
    });
  }
  const long = rows.flatMap((d) => [
    { date: d.date, side: "W", v: d.c_W, label: d.label },   // not "White"/"Black": Plot would
    { date: d.date, side: "B", v: d.c_B, label: d.label },   // read those as CSS colours
  ]).filter((d) => Number.isFinite(d.v));
  const ext = d3.extent([...long.map((d) => d.v), ...rows.map((d) => d.c_total).filter(Number.isFinite),
    ...rows.map((d) => Math.max(0, d.c_W) + Math.max(0, d.c_B)).filter(Number.isFinite),
    ...rows.map((d) => Math.min(0, d.c_W) + Math.min(0, d.c_B)).filter(Number.isFinite), 0]);
  const cands = [-0.9, -0.75, -0.5, -0.33, -0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 2, 4, 9];
  const slack = P && !P.legacy ? 0 : 0.05;   // on screen and in the banner a tick may sit just past the data; the phone exports keep ticks inside the plot
  const ticks = cands.map((p) => Math.log(1 + p)).filter((t) => t >= ext[0] - slack && t <= ext[1] + slack);
  const fmt = (t) => { const p = Math.exp(t) - 1; return Math.abs(p) < 1e-9 ? "0%" : `${p > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(100 * p)}%`; };
  return Plot.plot({
    width: w, ...L,
    x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [monthDate(ix, m0), d3.utcMonth.offset(monthDate(ix, m1), 1)], ...xTicks(P, w, L.marginLeft) },
    y: { label: "change vs window start (log scale)", ticks: thin(ticks, yMax(P, L)), tickFormat: fmt, grid: true },
    color: { domain: ["W", "B"], range: [COL.white, COL.black] },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(long, { x: "date", interval: "month", y: "v", fill: "side", order: ["W", "B"], insetLeft: 0.5, insetRight: 0.5, fillOpacity: 0.9 }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: COL.ink, strokeOpacity: 0.4 }),
      Plot.lineY(rows, { x: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d.date, 14), y: "c_total", stroke: COL.ink, strokeWidth: 1.5 }),
      Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d.date, 14), stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1 })),
      Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d.date, 14), y: "c_total",
        title: (d) => `${d.label}\nNet    ${fmt(d.c_total)}\n${pside ? `${sideMoves("W")}  ${fmt(d.c_W)}\n${sideMoves("B")}  ${fmt(d.c_B)}` : `White  ${fmt(d.c_W)}\nBlack  ${fmt(d.c_B)}`}\n(log contributions add: ${d.c_W?.toFixed(3)} + ${d.c_B?.toFixed(3)} = ${d.c_total?.toFixed(3)})` })),
    ],
  });
}
```

## 3 · How often would you see it, and how often would your opponent?

```{ojs}
// Local to this panel. Default: the side that plays the line's last move,
// i.e. the side "choosing" the opening.
viewof persp = Inputs.select(["White", "Black", "Both sides"], { label: "Perspective",
  value: inTree === 0 ? "Both sides" : inTree % 2 ? "White" : "Black" })
```

```{ojs}
{
  const P = persp;
  const tile = (k, v, s, color, cls = "") => `<div class="dash-tile${cls}"><div class="k">${color ? key(color) : ""}${k}</div><div class="v">${v}</div><div class="s">${s}</div></div>`;
  let tiles;
  if (P === "Both sides") {
    const r = win.spec_edge_white;   // B ÷ W: > 1 favours White, < 1 favours Black
    const fav = !Number.isFinite(r) ? "—" : r > 1 ? `favours White ${times2(r)}` : r < 1 ? `favours Black ${times2(win.spec_edge_black)}` : "even (1.00×)";
    // v2.0: with a player and a colour chosen, the tiles name the player and the opponents
    const gets = (side) => { const x = sideWho(side); return `${esc(x)} (${side === "W" ? "White" : "Black"}'s moves) ${x === "Opponents" ? "get" : "gets"} it`; };
    const decide = (side) => { const x = sideWho(side); return x === "Opponents" ? "the opponents'" : `${esc(x)}'s`; };
    tiles = pside ? [
      tile(gets("W"), oneIn(win.E_white), `E<sub>White</sub> = B: ${decide("B")} moves decide`, COL.white),
      tile(gets("B"), oneIn(win.E_black), `E<sub>Black</sub> = W: ${decide("W")} moves decide`, COL.black),
      tile("Specialist edge", fav, `E<sub>White</sub> ÷ E<sub>Black</sub> = B ÷ W = ${times2(r)}: how many times more often ${esc(sideWho("W"))} (White) reach${sideWho("W") === "Opponents" ? "" : "es"} this than ${esc(sideWho("B"))} (Black)`, null, " dash-spec"),
    ] : [
      tile("A White specialist gets it", oneIn(win.E_white), `E<sub>White</sub> = B: Black's moves decide`, COL.white),
      tile("A Black specialist gets it", oneIn(win.E_black), `E<sub>Black</sub> = W: White's moves decide`, COL.black),
      tile("Specialist edge", fav, `E<sub>White</sub> ÷ E<sub>Black</sub> = B ÷ W = ${times2(r)}: how many times more often a White specialist reaches this than a Black one`, null, " dash-spec"),
    ];
  } else if (pside) {
    // v2.0: a player with a colour chosen: the tiles name the player and the opponents (colours by board side)
    const w = P === "White", O = w ? "Black" : "White";
    const me = sideWho(w ? "W" : "B"), them = sideWho(w ? "B" : "W");
    const plays = (x) => x === "Opponents" ? "play" : "plays", poss = (x) => x === "Opponents" ? "the opponents'" : `${x}'s`;
    const Eyou = w ? win.E_white : win.E_black, Eopp = w ? win.E_black : win.E_white;
    const spec = w ? win.spec_edge_white : win.spec_edge_black;
    tiles = [
      tile(`${esc(me)} (always ${plays(me)} ${P}'s moves)`, oneIn(Eyou), `E<sub>${P}</sub> = ${w ? "B" : "W"}: ${esc(poss(them))} moves decide`, w ? COL.white : COL.black),
      tile(`${esc(them)} (${O}'s moves) ${them === "Opponents" ? "get" : "gets"} it`, oneIn(Eopp), `E<sub>${O}</sub> = ${w ? "W" : "B"}: ${esc(poss(me))} moves decide`, w ? COL.black : COL.white),
      tile("Specialist edge", times2(spec), `E<sub>${P}</sub> ÷ E<sub>${O}</sub> = ${w ? "B ÷ W" : "W ÷ B"}: how many times more often ${esc(me === "Opponents" ? "the opponents reach" : `${me} reaches`)} this than ${esc(them === "Opponents" ? "the opponents do" : `${them} does`)}, as ${O}`, null, " dash-spec"),
    ];
  } else {
    const w = P === "White", O = w ? "Black" : "White";
    const Eyou = w ? win.E_white : win.E_black, Eopp = w ? win.E_black : win.E_white;
    const spec = w ? win.spec_edge_white : win.spec_edge_black;
    tiles = [
      tile(`You (always play ${P}'s moves)`, oneIn(Eyou), `E<sub>${P}</sub> = ${w ? "B" : "W"}: your opponent's moves decide`, w ? COL.white : COL.black),
      tile(`Your opponent (a ${O} specialist) gets it`, oneIn(Eopp), `E<sub>${O}</sub> = ${w ? "W" : "B"}: ${P}'s moves decide`, w ? COL.black : COL.white),
      tile("Specialist edge", times2(spec), `E<sub>you</sub> ÷ E<sub>opponent</sub> = ${w ? "B ÷ W" : "W ÷ B"}: how many times more often you reach this than an opponent who specialises in ${O}`, null, " dash-spec"),
    ];
  }
  return D(`<div class="dash-tiles">${tiles.join("")}</div>`);
}
```

::: {.dash-panel}
## 4 · The move path

```{ojs}
{
  if (!res.cnt) return D(`<p class="dash-note">No moves yet.</p>`);
  const c = win.c, T = win.T, n = win.n;
  const fin = c.filter(Number.isFinite);
  const minC = fin.length ? Math.min(...fin) : NaN;
  const body = res.cnt.edges.map((e, i) => {
    const side = (i % 2 === 0 ? "White" : "Black") + (pside ? ` (${esc(sideWho(i % 2 === 0 ? "W" : "B"))})` : "");
    const col = i % 2 === 0 ? COL.white : COL.black;
    const thin = T[i] < (srcE === "otb" ? 1 : 30) || n[i] < 1;   // v2.0.1: no minimum game count for OTB
    const label = `${Math.floor(i / 2) + 1}.${i % 2 === 0 ? "" : ".."} ${esc(e.san)}`;
    const bar = Number.isFinite(c[i]) ? `<span class="dash-bar" style="width:${Math.max(1, 160 * c[i])}px;background:${col}"></span>` : "";
    return `<tr class="${c[i] === minC ? "rare" : ""}"><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${key(col)} ${side}</td><td class="dash-moves">${label}</td>
      <td class="num">${thin ? `<span class="dash-gap">${pct(c[i])}</span>` : pct(c[i])}</td><td>${bar}</td>
      <td class="num">${d3.format(",")(n[i])}</td><td class="num">${d3.format(",")(T[i])}</td></tr>`;
  }).join("");
  return D(`<p class="dash-sub">Each move's share among the games that reached the position before it, pooled over the window.
  W multiplies the blue rows and B the orange ones. The rarest move is highlighted.</p>
  <table class="dash-path"><thead><tr><th>Ply</th><th>Side</th><th>Move</th><th class="num">c<sub>i</sub></th><th></th>
  <th class="num">Played</th><th class="num">Reached</th></tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table>
  <p class="dash-copy">Window: W = <b>${pct(win.W)}</b>, B = <b>${pct(win.B)}</b>, W×B = <b>${pct(win.WxB)}</b>,
  true reach = <b>${pct(win.reach)}</b> of ${d3.format(",")(win.N)} games.</p>
  <div class="dash-note">${popNote}</div>`);
}
```

::: {.dash-note}
Data, Lichess Online Games: the Lichess open database, rated standard games 2013-01 to 2026-07, through a per-month opening-tree extract
(counts summed over ply, the Lichess-explorer convention). Bots, arena/swiss games and abandoned or cheat-terminated
games are excluded. Rating bands are by the two players' average rating. Opening names: lichess-org/chess-openings.

Data, Classical OTB Games: over-the-board games from The Week in Chess, Lichess broadcasts and other archives, deduplicated,
2013-01 to 2026-10, at a verified classical time control only. Each event's time control was reviewed against archived
reports and clocks; rapid, blitz and games of unclear speed are left out, as are correspondence and engine games.
**SuperGMs** are the games in which one player was rated strictly above 2700 and the other at least 2600, by the ratings
recorded with the game (not peak ratings). Each **player** set holds one of 47 leading players' classical games against
every opponent and at every age, juniors' early games included; a game between two of the 47 counts in both players'
sets. A month holds tens to a few hundred such games, so every OTB point pools a rolling 12 months (the trailing 12
months of counts, with 95% intervals from the pooled counts), and Compare pools both sets the same way whenever either
is OTB. OTB points have no minimum game count (Lichess points need 30 games at each step), so a point resting on a handful
of games is shown with its wide interval; a player's line can rest on very few games. The 2020 gap is real: classical over-the-board events largely stopped during the pandemic. The moves are counted
exactly as for Lichess (the first 30 plies, positions on the named-opening tree).
The data cover the positions on the named lines and every move between two of them. Panel 1's win percentages are
the results of the games that reach a named opening's final position by any move order, counted from White's side. Board: chess.js (BSD-2-Clause).
Chess pieces by Colin M.L. Burnett (Cburnett), via Wikimedia Commons, used under the BSD licence
([licence and sources](pieces/LICENSE.txt)).
:::

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ---- v1.9, the Compare tab: the line under Set A and Set B, drawn in the same charts ----
// Nothing here computes or draws while Explore is selected.
cmpOn = tab === "compare"
cmp = cmpOn ? store.compare(line, setA, setB, m0, m1, smoothC) : null
cmpReady = !!(cmp && cmp.ser)
CMP_SET_KEYS = ["W", "B", "WxB", "reach", "reach_lo", "reach_hi", "score", "score_lo", "score_hi", "res_n", "win_w", "win_d", "win_b",
  "spec_edge_white", "spec_edge_white_lo", "spec_edge_white_hi", "spec_edge_black", "spec_edge_black_lo", "spec_edge_black_hi"]
cmpRows = cmpReady ? d3.range(m0, m1 + 1).map((m) => {
  const r = { m, date: monthDate(ix, m), label: monthLabel(ix, m) };
  const fin = (x) => (Number.isFinite(x) ? x : NaN);
  for (const k of CMP_SET_KEYS) { r[`a_${k}`] = fin(cmp.a.ser[k][m]); r[`b_${k}`] = fin(cmp.b.ser[k][m]); }
  for (const k of dashMod.COMPARE_KEYS) r[k] = fin(cmp.ser[k][m]);
  return r;
}) : []
gw = cmpReady ? cmp.win : ({})
wa = cmpReady ? cmp.a.win : ({})
wb = cmpReady ? cmp.b.win : ({})
speedText = (sp) => sp.length === ix.speeds.length ? "all speeds" : sp.length ? sp.join(" + ") : "no speeds"
bandText = (bd) => {
  if (bd.length === ix.bands.length) return "all ratings";
  if (!bd.length) return "no ratings";
  const s = bandSummary(ix.bands, ix.band_labels)(bd, ix.bands).replace(/^Rating: /, "");
  if (/^under \d+$/.test(s)) return `<${s.slice(6)}`;
  if (/ bands$/.test(s)) return ix.bands.filter((b) => bd.includes(b)).map((b) => ix.band_labels[ix.bands.indexOf(b)]).join(", ");
  return s;
}
// v2.0: an OTB set is named by its source; with any OTB set in view a Lichess set says "Lichess, ..." too
setDesc = (S) => S.src === "otb" ? `Classical OTB, ${otbDesc(S)}` : `${anyOtbC ? "Lichess, " : ""}${speedText(S.speeds)}, ${bandText(S.bands)}`
setsLine = `A: ${setDesc(setA)} · B: ${setDesc(setB)}`
setPop = (S) => S.src === "otb" ? `classical OTB games, ${otbDesc(S)}` : `Lichess rated standard games (no arena/swiss, no bots), ${speedText(S.speeds)}, ${bandText(S.bands)}`
cmpPopNote = !anyOtbC ? `Lichess rated standard games (no arena/swiss, no bots), ${monthLabel(ix, m0)}–${monthLabel(ix, m1)}. `
  + `Set A: ${setDesc(setA)}; Set B: ${setDesc(setB)}. ` + (smoothC === 3 ? "Monthly, counts pooled over 3 months." : "Monthly.")
  : `Set A: ${setPop(setA)}; Set B: ${setPop(setB)}. ${monthLabel(ix, m0)}–${monthLabel(ix, m1)}. `
    + "Both sets pooled over a rolling 12 months (each monthly point pools the trailing 12), so the gap compares like with like."
cmpSource = !anyOtbC ? "Source: dnield.com/openings · Lichess open database"
  : setA.src === "otb" && setB.src === "otb" ? `Source: dnield.com/openings · ${OTB_CREDIT}`
  : `Source: dnield.com/openings · Lichess open database · ${OTB_CREDIT}`
// a Compare chart's PNG export: as Explore's, with both sets named in the subtitle and the footer
cmpSpec = (panel, panelSlug, build, legend, footNote) => ({
  build, legend,
  title: `${chartName.title} — ${panel}`,
  subtitle: `${setsLine}. ${chartName.subtitle}`,
  footer: footNote ? `${cmpPopNote} ${footNote}` : cmpPopNote,
  source: cmpSource,
  filename: `opening_${chartName.slug}_${panelSlug}_${monthLabel(ix, m0)}_${monthLabel(ix, m1)}.png`,
})
// B vs A from a log gap: a ratio ("2.30×") or a log-percent change ("+40%")
xr = (t) => Number.isFinite(t) ? times2(Math.exp(t)) : "—"
gapPct = (t) => {
  if (!Number.isFinite(t)) return "—";
  const r = Math.round(100 * (Math.exp(t) - 1));
  return r === 0 ? "0%" : `${r > 0 ? "+" : ""}${d3.format(",")(r)}%`;
}
ctile = (k, v, s, color) => `<div class="dash-tile"><div class="k">${color ? key(color) : ""}${k}</div><div class="v">${v}</div><div class="s">${s}</div></div>`
// a chart's place taken by a note, with its Download disabled (as Explore's "not available" state)
noteBox = (msg, why) => {
  const box = chartWithDownload(D(`<p class="dash-callout dash-unavail">${msg}</p>`), () => null);
  const b = box.querySelector(".dash-dl");
  b.disabled = true; b.classList.add("off"); b.title = why;
  return box;
}
setLegend = (extra = "") => `<div class="dash-legend"><span>${key(SET.a, "thick")} Set A: ${esc(setDesc(setA))}</span>
  <span>${key(SET.b, "thick")} Set B: ${esc(setDesc(setB))}</span>${extra}</div>`
setLegendExport = (extra = []) => [{ label: `Set A: ${setDesc(setA)}`, color: SET.a, kind: "line" },
  { label: `Set B: ${setDesc(setB)}`, color: SET.b, kind: "line" }, ...extra]
// on-screen y ticks for the gap chart: at most this many (exports use their own budget)
thinScreen = (P, L, k = 8) => P && !P.legacy ? yMax(P, L) : k
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (!cmpOn) return html``;
  const parts = [anyOtbC ? `<p class="dash-sub">One opening under two filter sets, drawn in the same charts:
    <b>Set A</b> (${esc(setDesc(setA))}, ink) and <b>Set B</b> (${esc(setDesc(setB))}, aqua). Choose each set's source and
    filters above; the line and the window are shared with Explore. With a Classical OTB set in the comparison, both sets
    are pooled over a rolling 12 months, so the gap compares like with like.</p>`
    : `<p class="dash-sub">One opening under two filter sets, drawn in the same charts:
    <b>Set A</b> (${esc(setDesc(setA))}, ink) and <b>Set B</b> (${esc(setDesc(setB))}, aqua). Choose each set's speeds and
    ratings above; the line, the window and the pooling are shared with Explore.</p>`];
  if (!cmpReady) parts.push(`<p class="dash-callout">Make a move on the board (or pick a named opening) to compare it between the two sets.</p>`);
  else if (cmp.same) parts.push(`<p class="dash-callout dash-same"><b>The two sets are the same</b>, so there is no gap between them to show.
    Change Set A's or Set B's speeds or ratings above.</p>`);
  else if (cmp.overlap && setA.src === "otb") {
    // v2.0: two OTB sets can share games (roster players' mutual games; a player's elite games are SuperGMs games too)
    parts.push(`<p class="dash-callout dash-overlap"><b>The sets can share games:</b> a game between two of the roster players
      counts in both players' sets, and a player's games against the elite count among the SuperGMs' too. Shared games make
      the gap smaller than between separate groups, and the 95% intervals, which treat the sets as independent, are only approximate.</p>`);
  }
  else if (cmp.overlap) {
    const sp = setA.speeds.filter((s) => setB.speeds.includes(s)), bd = setA.bands.filter((b) => setB.bands.includes(b));
    parts.push(`<p class="dash-callout dash-overlap"><b>The sets overlap:</b> games at ${esc(speedText(sp))}, ${esc(bandText(bd))} count in
      both, so the two sets share games. The gap between them is smaller than between separate groups would be, and the 95% intervals,
      which treat the sets as independent, are only approximate.</p>`);
  }
  for (const [nm, S] of [["Set A", setA], ["Set B", setB]])
    if (cmpReady && S.src !== "otb" && (!S.speeds.length || !S.bands.length)) parts.push(`<p class="dash-callout dash-empty">${nm} selects no games: choose at least one speed and one rating band.</p>`);
  return D(parts.join(""));
}
```

::: {.dash-cpanel}
## 2 · Who explains the gap?

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// B vs A per month, split exactly: White's part gap_W = log(W_B/W_A) and Black's gap_B = log(B_B/B_A)
// stack to the net gap_WxB = log(WxB_B/WxB_A). The same log-percent axis as panel 2's Attribution view.
cchart2 = (w, h, P) => {
  const L = plotLayout(P, h, w, { hDefault: 300, mlBanner: 68, mlK: 4.1 });
  const long = cmpRows.flatMap((d) => [
    { date: d.date, side: "W", v: d.gap_W },   // "W"/"B", not "White"/"Black" (Plot reads those as colours)
    { date: d.date, side: "B", v: d.gap_B },
  ]).filter((d) => Number.isFinite(d.v));
  const ext = d3.extent([...long.map((d) => d.v), ...cmpRows.map((d) => d.gap_WxB).filter(Number.isFinite),
    ...cmpRows.map((d) => Math.max(0, d.gap_W) + Math.max(0, d.gap_B)).filter(Number.isFinite),
    ...cmpRows.map((d) => Math.min(0, d.gap_W) + Math.min(0, d.gap_B)).filter(Number.isFinite), 0]);
  const cands = [-0.99, -0.98, -0.95, -0.9, -0.8, -0.75, -0.6, -0.5, -0.33, -0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 9, 19, 49, 99];
  const slack = P && !P.legacy ? 0 : 0.05;
  const ticks = cands.map((p) => Math.log(1 + p)).filter((t) => t >= ext[0] - slack && t <= ext[1] + slack);
  // a gap between two sets can span a wide range, where the candidates crowd around 0: keep 0, then walk
  // outwards keeping only ticks at least 1/(k-1) of the range apart (k = the tick budget)
  const minGap = 0.9 * (ext[1] - ext[0]) / Math.max(1, thinScreen(P, L) - 1);
  const walk = (side) => { const out = []; let last = 0;
    for (const t of side) if (Math.abs(t - last) >= minGap) { out.push(t); last = t; }
    return out; };
  const spaced = [...walk(ticks.filter((t) => t < 0).sort((a, b) => b - a)).reverse(), ...(ticks.includes(0) ? [0] : []),
    ...walk(ticks.filter((t) => t > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b))];
  return Plot.plot({
    width: w, ...L,
    x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [monthDate(ix, m0), d3.utcMonth.offset(monthDate(ix, m1), 1)], ...xTicks(P, w, L.marginLeft) },
    y: { label: "B vs A (log scale)", ticks: spaced, tickFormat: gapPct, grid: true },
    color: { domain: ["W", "B"], range: [COL.white, COL.black] },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(long, { x: "date", interval: "month", y: "v", fill: "side", order: ["W", "B"], insetLeft: 0.5, insetRight: 0.5, fillOpacity: 0.9 }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: COL.ink, strokeOpacity: 0.4 }),
      Plot.lineY(cmpRows, { x: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d.date, 14), y: "gap_WxB", stroke: COL.ink, strokeWidth: 1.5 }),
      Plot.ruleX(cmpRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d.date, 14), stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1 })),
      Plot.tip(cmpRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d.date, 14), y: "gap_WxB",
        title: (d) => `${d.label}  (B vs A)\nNet, W×B  ${gapPct(d.gap_WxB)}   A ${pct(d.a_WxB)} · B ${pct(d.b_WxB)}\nWhite (W)  ${gapPct(d.gap_W)}   A ${pct(d.a_W)} · B ${pct(d.b_W)}\nBlack (B)  ${gapPct(d.gap_B)}   A ${pct(d.a_B)} · B ${pct(d.b_B)}\n(log parts add: ${d.gap_W?.toFixed(3)} + ${d.gap_B?.toFixed(3)} = ${d.gap_WxB?.toFixed(3)})` })),
    ],
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
    <span>${key(COL.ink)} Net: W×B in B vs A</span></div>`;

    "B vs A: White's part log(W_B / W_A) plus Black's part log(B_B / B_A) is the net log(W×B_B / W×B_A) exactly; +40% means 40% more common in B."));
  return html`${D(sub + legend)}${box}<div class="dash-note">${cmpPopNote}</div>

  White's moves account for <b>×${Number.isFinite(gw.gap_W) ? times2(Math.exp(gw.gap_W)).replace("×", "") : "—"}</b>, Black's for
  <b>×${Number.isFinite(gw.gap_B) ? times2(Math.exp(gw.gap_B)).replace("×", "") : "—"}</b> (the two multiply to the net exactly).
  By true reach, any move order, it is ${xr(gw.gap_net)}.</p>`;
}
```

## 3 · How does it score, A vs B?

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// both sets' average score on the zoomed score axis of v1.7.1, fitted to both sets' visible bands
cScoreDomain = {
  const v = cmpRows.flatMap((d) => [d.a_score_lo, d.a_score_hi, d.b_score_lo, d.b_score_hi]).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const lo = v.length ? d3.min(v) : 0.5, hi = v.length ? d3.max(v) : 0.5, padY = 0.1 * (hi - lo);
  let a = lo - padY, b = hi + padY;
  if (b - a < 0.04) { const mid = (lo + hi) / 2; a = mid - 0.02; b = mid + 0.02; }
  if (a < 0) { b = Math.min(1, b - a); a = 0; }
  if (b > 1) { a = Math.max(0, a - (b - 1)); b = 1; }
  return [a, b];
}
cScoreTicks = (k) => {
  const [a, b] = cScoreDomain;
  for (const st of [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2]) {
    const t = d3.range(Math.ceil(a / st - 1e-9), Math.floor(b / st + 1e-9) + 1).map((i) => +(i * st).toFixed(2));
    if (t.length <= k || st === 0.2) return t;
  }
}
cchart3 = (w, h, P) => { const L = plotLayout(P, h, w, { hDefault: 300, mlBanner: 68, mlK: 3.6 }); return Plot.plot({
  width: w, ...L,
  x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [monthDate(ix, m0), monthDate(ix, m1)], ...xTicks(P, w, L.marginLeft) },
  y: { type: "linear", label: "average score (White's view)", domain: cScoreDomain, grid: true,
       ticks: cScoreTicks(Math.min(6, yMax(P, L))), tickFormat: d3.format(".2f") },
  marks: [
    ...(cScoreDomain[0] <= 0.5 && 0.5 <= cScoreDomain[1] ? [
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1, strokeDasharray: "4,3", ariaLabel: () => "even-rule" }),
      Plot.text([0.5], { y: (d) => d, text: () => "even", frameAnchor: "right", textAnchor: "end", lineAnchor: "bottom", dy: -3,
        fill: COL.prod, ariaLabel: () => "even-label" })] : []),
    Plot.areaY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y1: "a_score_lo", y2: "a_score_hi", fill: SET.a, fillOpacity: 0.12, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.areaY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y1: "b_score_lo", y2: "b_score_hi", fill: SET.b, fillOpacity: 0.2, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.lineY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y: "a_score", stroke: SET.a, strokeWidth: 2.25, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.lineY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y: "b_score", stroke: SET.b, strokeWidth: 2.25, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.ruleX(cmpRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1 })),
    Plot.tip(cmpRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "b_score",
      title: (d) => `${d.label}\nA  ${sc(d.a_score)}  (${sc(d.a_score_lo)}–${sc(d.a_score_hi)})  ${games(d.a_res_n)} games\nB  ${sc(d.b_score)}  (${sc(d.b_score_lo)}–${sc(d.b_score_hi)})  ${games(d.b_res_n)} games` })),
  ],
}) }
```

```{ojs}

  if (!cmpReady) return html``;

    return html`${noteBox(`Monthly results are available for the named openings' final positions. Enter or pick a named opening.`,
      "Nothing to download: monthly results are available for the named openings' final positions")}<div class="dash-note">${cmpPopNote}</div>`;

      `White ${pct(w.win_w)} · Draw ${pct(w.win_d)} · Black ${pct(w.win_b)} · ${games(w.res_n)} games`
      + (ps ? ` · ${esc(shortOf(S.who))}'s score ${sc(ps === "white" ? w.score : 1 - w.score)}` : ""), color); };
  const box = chartWithDownload(cchart3(Math.max(240, Math.min(width, 1100))), () => cmpSpec("How does it score, A vs B?", "compare-score",
    (w, h, P) => cchart3(w, h, P), setLegendExport([{ label: "95% interval on the score", color: COL.muted, kind: "area" }]), RESULTS_FOOT));
  return html`${D(`<div class="dash-tiles">${t("Set A", setA, wa, SET.a)}${t("Set B", setB, wb, SET.b)}</div>${setLegend(`<span>shaded: 95% interval on the score</span>`)}`)}${box}
  <div class="dash-note">${cmpPopNote} ${RESULTS_FOOT}</div>`;
}
```

## 4 · Specialist edge, A vs B

```{ojs}
viewof persp4 = Inputs.select(["White", "Black"], { label: "Perspective", value: inTree % 2 || inTree === 0 ? "White" : "Black" })
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// the specialist edge (v1.8) in each set: White B ÷ W, Black W ÷ B, with an "equal" rule at 1×
edgeKey4 = persp4 === "White" ? "spec_edge_white" : "spec_edge_black"
edgeFmt = (d) => `${+(+d).toPrecision(3)}×`
cchart4 = (w, h, P) => {
  const L = plotLayout(P, h, w, { hDefault: 280, mlBanner: 76, mlK: 3.6 });
  const k = edgeKey4;
  // the domain covers the bands and 1x, padded 5% (log) each side, so the "equal" rule never sits on the frame
  const vals = [1, ...cmpRows.flatMap((d) => [d[`a_${k}_lo`], d[`a_${k}_hi`], d[`b_${k}_lo`], d[`b_${k}_hi`]])].filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x) && x > 0);
  const dom = [d3.min(vals) / 1.05, d3.max(vals) * 1.05];
  return Plot.plot({
    width: w, ...L,
    x: { type: "utc", label: null, domain: [monthDate(ix, m0), monthDate(ix, m1)], ...xTicks(P, w, L.marginLeft) },
    y: { type: "log", label: `${persp4} specialist edge (${persp4 === "White" ? "B ÷ W" : "W ÷ B"})`, grid: true, tickFormat: edgeFmt, domain: dom,
         ticks: thin(logTicks(vals)?.filter((t) => t >= dom[0] && t <= dom[1]), yMax(P, L)) },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([1], { stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1, strokeDasharray: "4,3", ariaLabel: () => "equal-rule" }),
      Plot.text([1], { y: (d) => d, text: () => "equal", frameAnchor: "right", textAnchor: "end", lineAnchor: "bottom", dy: -3,
        fill: COL.prod, ariaLabel: () => "equal-label" }),
      Plot.areaY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y1: `a_${k}_lo`, y2: `a_${k}_hi`, fill: SET.a, fillOpacity: 0.12, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.areaY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y1: `b_${k}_lo`, y2: `b_${k}_hi`, fill: SET.b, fillOpacity: 0.2, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.lineY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y: `a_${k}`, stroke: SET.a, strokeWidth: 2.25, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.lineY(cmpRows, { x: "date", y: `b_${k}`, stroke: SET.b, strokeWidth: 2.25, curve: "monotone-x" }),
      Plot.ruleX(cmpRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", stroke: COL.muted, strokeWidth: 1 })),
      Plot.tip(cmpRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: `b_${k}`,
        title: (d) => `${d.label}\n${persp4} specialist edge\nA  ${times2(d[`a_${k}`])}\nB  ${times2(d[`b_${k}`])}` })),
    ],
  });
}
```

```{ojs}

    `how many times more often a ${persp4} specialist reaches this than a ${O} specialist, in each set`, null);

  <div class="dash-note">${cmpPopNote}</div>`;
}
```
